evidence.title: Contrabass README
evidence.locator: Current scope; Requirements; How Contrabass works; Supported integrations; Web dashboard and HTTP API
evidence.finding: Terminal-first orchestrator for issue-driven agent runs, Go port of OpenAI Symphony; Linear, GitHub Issues and internal board trackers; Codex app-server, OpenCode, oh-my-opencode, OMX and OMC runners; git worktrees; teams; TUI, web dashboard, HTTP and MCP API.

evidence.title: Configuration
evidence.finding: Strict WORKFLOW.md validation, defaults, contrabass config effective.

evidence.title: Orchestrator configuration
evidence.finding: Backoff, shutdown, snapshot stage and ETA settings; unconfigurable invariants.

evidence.title: Local board tracker
evidence.finding: File-based internal board with states todo, in_progress, retry, done, parents, assignees, blocked-by edges, comments and a dispatch loop that picks the oldest runnable issue.

evidence.title: Enhanced Team Mode
evidence.locator: Features; Comparison with OMX/OMC; Deferred features
evidence.finding: Worker health, scaling, events, messaging, task claims, restart; approval system, git worktree support for team workers and merge coordinator are deferred.

evidence.title: Codex protocol notes
evidence.finding: Documents the JSONL framing used with codex app-server.

evidence.title: Web server
evidence.finding: Serves the embedded dashboard and JSON/SSE endpoints including stop, board CRUD and MCP stream.

evidence.title: MCP streamable HTTP
evidence.finding: External MCP agents can call a single tool, contrabass.dashboard_snapshot, with a 24-hour in-memory bearer token.

evidence.title: Orchestrator
evidence.finding: Orchestrator claims issues, tracks backoff entries and recovers orphan claims.

evidence.title: Tracker contract
evidence.finding: Linear (GraphQL), GitHub Issues (REST, PRs skipped) and local board adapters.

evidence.title: Codex runner
evidence.finding: Forwards workflow-level Codex approval policy and sandbox mode as -c overrides to codex app-server.

evidence.title: Update check
evidence.finding: Checks the GitHub releases API every 12 hours for a newer version; CONTRABASS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK disables it; notification suggests brew upgrade.

evidence.title: Workspace manager
evidence.finding: Creates a git worktree (or plain directory) under workspaces/<issue-id>.

evidence.title: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE)
evidence.finding: Repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0.

evidence.title: GitHub API for junhoyeo/contrabass
evidence.finding: Repository has 226 stars, license Apache-2.0, homepage contrabass.dev, last push 2026-07-17.

evidence.title: Contrabass v0.5.1 release
evidence.finding: v0.5.1 (2026-07-16) assets are macOS and Linux tarballs for amd64 and arm64 plus checksums; no Windows build.

evidence.title: Bounded search: pull request creation, review
evidence.finding: The only match is a GitHub adapter that skips pull requests when listing issues; no PR creation, review or merge code.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry, webhooks, sandbox
evidence.locator: rg -il "telemetry|analytics|sentry|posthog|webhook" internal cmd; rg -il "docker|container|bwrap" internal cmd
evidence.finding: No telemetry, analytics or webhook code; container/sandbox words appear only in the Codex sandbox-mode passthrough, config and TUI header text.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cost tracking
evidence.finding: No cost or price code; token counts (in/out) are tracked and shown.

evidence.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
evidence.finding: No SSO, roles or presence; the dashboard stream endpoint is tokenless and MCP uses a generated bearer token.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cron or schedules
evidence.finding: Only tracker polling (poll_interval_ms) and retry backoff; no cron-style scheduler.

evidence.title: Contrabass bounded source search
evidence.locator: rg -il over cmd internal packages docs (tests, lockfiles and node_modules excluded) for: embedding|vector store|semantic search|retriev|code search|indexing; memory store|skills|AGENTS.md|CLAUDE.md; screenshot|multimodal|image_url|base64; living spec|product spec|requirements doc/store/registry; mcp client|StdioClientTransport; takeover|take over|hand off|attach; dependency install|npm install|bun install|go mod download|cache dir|port alloc|docker compose; gallery|preview|recording
evidence.finding: No retrieval, indexing, memory, skills or instruction-import code (matches are unrelated words such as issue retrieval and TUI index comments, plus MCP server configuration text), no multimodal or screenshot handling, no product-spec or requirements store, no MCP client, no takeover or hand-off feature (git worktree attach and a Codex string only), no dependency, cache, port or service management, and no gallery, preview or recording feature.

evidence.title: Contrabass hooks configuration
evidence.locator: effective.go lines 148-150 (hooks.before_run, after_run, before_remove marked not implemented); config.go line 214 TODO on HooksConfig
evidence.finding: The effective-config report marks hooks.before_run, hooks.after_run and hooks.before_remove as parsed but hook execution is not implemented, matching the TODO on HooksConfig, so there is no environment setup hook.

evidence.title: Contrabass hosted-offering search
evidence.locator: rg -il "cloud|hosted|saas|e2b|modal|daytona" cmd internal --glob *.go; README and docs read for hosted or remote execution
evidence.finding: The search found no Go source mentioning a hosted service, cloud sandbox provider or SaaS component; the README and docs describe only a self-run binary with local, headless and tracker-polling operation.

evidence.title: Contrabass host-resource search
evidence.finding: No match in the Go sources: no CPU, memory or load inspection, so dispatch is bounded only by max_concurrency and not by host resources.

evidence.title: Contrabass v0.5.1 source
evidence.finding: No analytics or crash-reporting client in v0.5.1; showTeamTelemetry only toggles a local dashboard panel.
